title: A button is shown only to someone it works for: "Submit for approval", "Approve" and the sending buttons

steps.expect: No "Submit for approval" button and no "Actions" box. The top line reads "Still a draft. Next: <name> prepares it and submits it for approval — that is not yours to do."
steps.observed: Test BranchMgr: no Submit button, no Actions box; top line "Still a draft. Test BDM prepares it and submits it for approval — that is not yours to do. You will see it here when it comes to you."
steps.note: The line reads "Still a draft. Test BDM prepares it …" — without the word "Next:" the test shows.
steps.suggest: Still a draft. <name> prepares it and submits it for approval — that is not yours to do. You will see it here when it comes to you.

steps.observed: Test BDM (who prepared it) sees "Submit for approval".

steps.do: [BDM] remove every line (or leave a man-month quotation whose costing is still a draft) and open it again.
steps.expect: In place of the button: "⚠ Not ready to submit: …" saying exactly what to fix (e.g. "needs at least one line with a quantity and a rate").
steps.observed: With the only line's rate cleared (saved: "Quote saved."), the button is replaced by: "⚠ Not ready to submit: Before it can go further this quote needs at least one line with a quantity and a rate. Edit it to add them."

steps.do: [Marketing Executive] open the approved quotation they prepared; then Test BDM's approved quotation. Then [Branch Manager, whom the executive reports to] open the executive's quotation.
steps.expect: Their own: sending is offered — "✉ Send to client", "Open in Gmail", "Outlook (.eml)", "Three ways to send this" (owner, 15 Nov 2026, F1: the preparer sends). Test BDM's: no sending buttons; it reads "Test BDM … sends it to the client — sending is not yours to do." Test BranchMgr, within 24 hours of approval: no sending buttons; it reads "… sends it first. If it is still unsent 24 hours after its approval (from <date, time>), you may send it."
steps.observed: on the quotation Test MktExec prepared, sending offers only: nothing

steps.do: NEGATIVE · [Marketing Executive] type /quote-compose?id=<Test BDM's quotation> in the address bar.
steps.expect: Refused: "Test BDM … sends it to the client — sending is not yours to do."
steps.observed: typed address: HTTP 200 text/html; charset=UTF-8 — TEST COPY — not the live system. No e-mail is sent from here. Payments: Razorpay test keys only. T TB Inspection Services (TEST) « 🏠 Dashboard 🔍 Search record
